Start of game: Gain one of 13 random powers. Each is an Activate that spends its (X).
(3) Expedition Map: Recruit a permanent.
(1) Life Tap: Draw {tapDraw}. Take {tapDamage} damage.
(1) Steady Shot: Deal {shot} damage to the enemy hero.
(2) Ranching: Summon a Rush Token.
(1) Cat Cafe: Summon a Felinor Token.
(1) Ping: Pierce. Deal {ping} damage.
(2) Witness Value: Discover a Unit.
(2) Stitching: Discover two ({stitchCost}) Cost or less Units. Fuse them.
(1) Armor Up: Your hero gains {armor} Armor until your next turn.
(2) Die Insect: Deal {insect} damage to a random enemy.
(2) KY Brainstorm: Add a random KY card to your hand. Reduce the cost of all Spells in your hand by ({discount}).

(3) Terminus Tricks: Discover a Trap to summon.

radiant.text:
Indestructible
Start of game: Gain one of 13 random powers. Each is an Activate that spends its (X).
(3) Expedition Map: Recruit a permanent. Make it Radiant.
(1) Life Tap: Draw {tapDraw} from each player's deck.
(1) Steady Shot: Deal {shot} damage to the enemy hero. This permanently deals 2 more damage.
(2) Ranching: Summon a Radiant Rush Token.
(1) Cat Cafe: Summon a random Felinor.
(1) Ping: Pierce. Deal {ping} damage. If this kills a Unit, summon a Ghoul Token with its stats.
(2) Witness Value: Discover a Radiant Unit.
(2) Stitching: Discover two Radiant ({stitchCost}) Cost or less Units. Fuse them.
(1) Tank Up: Your hero gains {armor} Armor, then this power refreshes.
(2) Die Insect: Lucky 1. Deal {insect} damage to a random enemy.
(2) KY Brainstorm: Add a Radiant KY card to your hand. Reduce the cost of all Spells in your hand by ({discount}).
(2) Pluck: Add a random Radiant Fruit to your hand. It costs ({fruitCost}).
(3) Terminus Tricks: Discover a Radiant Trap to summon.
